predecessors.name: Principality of Abasgia
predecessors.text: Abasgia, the Black Sea coast between the Gumista and Bzyb rivers and its hinterland (Cliopatria's Georgia row, 724-777)

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Lazica
predecessors.text: Egrisi (Lazica), acquired by Leon II through a dynastic union in the 770s

successors.name: Kingdom of Georgia
successors.text: Abkhazia, Egrisi and Kartli, united under Bagrat III with the Iberian crown in 1008

ledger.x: 778: Leon II wins independence from Byzantium and founds the Kingdom of Abkhazia at Anacopia.

c. 778: Leon II adds Lazica (Egrisi) to Abasgia. 'Leon II exploited this dynastic union to acquire Lazica in the 770s.' The Lazica dossier ends its last shape in 777; this dossier starts the kingdom in 778.
786: the court moves from Anacopia to Kutaisi (infobox 'Anacopia (778-786), Kutaisi (786-1008)').
904: Constantine III annexes a significant part of Kartli.
930s: George II breaks Kakheti's Kvirike II.

c. 960: Kakheti wins back its lands. The Principality of Kakheti page: under Kvirike II the Abkhazian king raided Kakheti, in 959 Kvirike's brother Shurta handed him Ujarma, and 'Kakheti later reclaimed its lands after a truce with Leon III' (undated); the George II page has George dying in 957 on an expedition…
c. 973: the Abkhazian dominance over Tao-Klarjeti ends. The page gives 'almost sixty years' from 914; no end year is dated.
1008: Bagrat III unites Abkhazia and Iberia.

wars.name: Arab expedition of Marwan II into Abkhazia
wars.outcome: Marwan's expedition entered Abkhazia in 735-736 but 'dysentery, floods, and resistance under Leon I, with Iberian and Lazic allies' forced the Arabs to retreat.

wars.name: Constantine III's Kartli and Hereti campaigns
wars.outcome: Constantine III annexed a large part of Kartli in 904 and, allied with Kvirike I of Kakheti, invaded Hereti in 905 and divided its major strongholds; Adarnase IV and Bagrat later defeated and captured Constantine.

wars.name: Abkhazian hegemony over Tao-Klarjeti
wars.outcome: After Emir Yusuf's invasion of Armenia in 912 and Smbat I's death at Dvin in 914, Adarnase of Tao was left a vassal of Constantine III: 'almost sixty years of Abkhazian dominance over Tao-Klarjeti'.

wars.name: George II against Kvirike of Kakheti
wars.outcome: George II dispossessed Kvirike II in the 930s with the Gardabanian nobles; he died in 957 on an expedition against Kvirike's rebellion in Kartli and Leon III made an inconclusive peace; Kakheti recovered its lands after a later truce.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary of any kind; Kartli and the Kakheti side are readings of the pages' prose.
